label: PF Backlog 35
title: 0a discovery questions were never asked (360-degree discovery produced a hollow artifact)
body:
0a Discovery generated the 18 360-degree questions (3 perspectives) and wrote products/

/discovery-questions.json, but NOTHING asked them: no prompt was bridged, no answers were collected, and run_discovery() then synthesized EMPTY domain_analysis / stakeholder_map / user_personas (discovery_engine explicitly refuses to fabricate answers). Result: 360-degree discovery silently produced a hollow artifact and the pipeline advanced. Fixed: added core.interactive.ask_many() (queue N prompts, poll all, fall back to defaults); run_discovery() now accepts caller answers; pipeline_executor._collect_discovery_answers() bridges every question (auto mode defers to the agent) and _run_design_augmentations('0a') synthesizes docs/domain-analysis.md + stakeholder-map.md + user-personas.md + product-plan.md from the real answers. Verified: compileall + wired_audit green.
_note: verified: discovery questions bridged via panel/executor

dashboard_impact.reason: user-facing discovery surface exists (live 360-degree discovery panel)
